title: Engenheiro de qualidade
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


Atribuições:

  • Garantir que a documentação de qualidade específica do projeto, por exemplo, Plano de Qualidade do Projeto, Plano de Controle de Atividades, Planos de Inspeção e Teste, etc., sejam preparados e mantidos.
  • Coordenar o processo de gerenciamento de não conformidade dentro dos projetos, incluindo relatórios de todos os relatórios de não conformidade (NCR), facilitando proativamente o fechamento do NCR, identificando requisitos de ação corretiva, etc.
  • Gerenciar e realizar auditorias de qualidade de subcontratados e projetos, incluindo planejamento, execução e relatórios para medir a conformidade com os sistemas de gerenciamento e requisitos do cliente e avaliar a eficácia e o valor dos processos de negócios estabelecidos.
  • Fornecer suporte de gerenciamento de qualidade ao Gerenciamento da Cadeia de Suprimentos em relação à avaliação de fornecedores e subcontratados e gerenciamento de riscos.
  • Fazer contato com o Cliente e representantes de terceiros em questões relacionadas ao Gerenciamento de Qualidade dentro dos projetos.
  • Garantir o monitoramento da qualidade do produto e serviço do fornecedor e fornecer dados de desempenho para o processo de avaliação do fornecedor.
  • Gerenciar e coordenar recursos de inspeção de CQ de terceiros em conjunto com os Engenheiros de Pacotes e o Chefe de Qualidade, conforme apropriado.
  • Garantir que a documentação final seja revisada e validada de acordo com as especificações locais, internacionais, da empresa, do cliente e do projeto.




Requisitos desejados:

Desejável:


Residir no Centro do RJ;

Experiência com RNCs, elaboração de plano de ações, normas de qualidade vivência no campo industrial;

Formação em Engenharia Mecânica, de Qualidade ou correlatas;

Organização e foco;

Inglês avançado.

title: Analista de pré-vendas de infraestrutura de ti
description:
Consultoria em Soluções Tecnológicas

Se você é um profissional de TI com interesse em atuar estrategicamente na pré-venda de soluções de infraestrutura e busca transformar necessidades de clientes em soluções personalizadas, essa é a oportunidade ideal. Na Decatron, valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossa equipe, oferecendo um ambiente colaborativo e inovador que promove o aprendizado e o crescimento.


Responsabilidades

·        Acompanhar a equipe de vendas em reuniões com clientes para entender as necessidades do negócio e oferecer soluções personalizadas.

·        Desenvolver desenhos, fluxos e propostas técnicas para projetos de infraestrutura.

·        Analisar RFIs, RFQs, RFPs e editais, assegurando a elaboração de propostas assertivas e alinhadas com os requisitos técnicos.

·        Realizar avaliações de ambiente de TI dos clientes, conduzindo site surveys e utilizando ferramentas de assessment e planejamento de capacidade.

·        Manter-se atualizado com avanços tecnológicos e aprofundar-se nas soluções do portfólio da empresa, com foco em ambientes on-premise e nuvem.

·        Colaborar com os Arquitetos de Soluções e a equipe comercial na qualificação e desenvolvimento de oportunidades de vendas.

·        Apoiar os arquitetos no processo técnico de venda desde a qualificação da oportunidade até o fechamento do negócio.

·        Realizar análises da concorrência e identificar diferenciais competitivos para posicionamento estratégico.

Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Soluções Analíticas

Propor soluções técnicas sólidas, sustentáveis e alinhadas às necessidades de negócio.

Traduzir descobertas complexas em relatórios, apresentações e dashboards claros para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Apoiar a definição de business cases, custos e objetivos estratégicos.
Definir, monitorar e gerenciar planos, orçamentos, KPIs e métricas de performance de campanhas e iniciativas de advocacy.

Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências em analytics, mídia digital e advocacy.
Compartilhar melhores práticas e promover a cultura de dados dentro da equipe.

Supervisionar e garantir a qualidade das entregas analíticas (quando aplicável).

Manipulação e análise de dados: SQL, Python, R, Excel.
Ferramentas de visualização de dados: Power BI (ou equivalentes).
Forte entendimento de métodos estatísticos e métricas de performance em mídia e advocacy.
Capacidade de traduzir análises complexas em recomendações claras para áreas de negócio.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com foco em storytelling de dados.
Atenção a detalhes e compromisso com a precisão.
Desejável: experiência prévia em análise de dados de campanhas digitais, engajamento em redes sociais, mídia paga/orgânica e iniciativas de advocacy.

  • Instalação de Infraestrutura Elétrica: Montar e instalar eletrodutos (embutidos ou aparentes), caixas de passagem, conduítes e outros elementos que compõem a infraestrutura para a passagem da fiação elétrica.
  • Passagem de Fiação e Cabos: Realizar a passagem de fios e cabos elétricos pelos eletrodutos, identificando-os e organizando-os conforme o projeto.
  • Montagem e Conexão de Dispositivos: Instalar e conectar interruptores, tomadas, luminárias, sensores, disjuntores, fusíveis, contatores e outros dispositivos elétricos.
  • Montagem e Ligação de Quadros de Distribuição: Montar e realizar as conexões elétricas em quadros de distribuição (QDG, QDL, etc.), organizando os circuitos e instalando os dispositivos de proteção (disjuntores, DRs, DPSs).
  • Instalação de Sistemas Elétricos Temporários: Montar e manter as instalações elétricas provisórias no canteiro de obras (iluminação, alimentação de equipamentos, etc.), seguindo as normas de segurança.
  • Testes e Verificações: Realizar testes de continuidade, isolamento, tensão e funcionamento dos sistemas elétricos, utilizando instrumentos de medição (multímetro, terrômetro, etc.), para garantir a conformidade com as normas e o projeto.
  • Manutenção Preventiva e Corretiva: Realizar inspeções periódicas nas instalações elétricas, identificando e corrigindo falhas, realizando a substituição de componentes danificados e garantindo o bom funcionamento dos sistemas.
  • Segurança do Trabalho: Cumprir rigorosamente as normas de segurança do trabalho, utilizando os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) adequados e seguindo os procedimentos de segurança para trabalhos em altura, com eletricidade e em espaços confinados, quando aplicável.

Local de atuação: Complexo Hospitalar Municipal Souza Aguiar | Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário:
Diarista:8h as 18h de segunda a quinta-feira | 8h as 17h na sexta-feira.

O que precisamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência comprovada em manutenção de sistemas elétricos, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais.

A Lobie é a proptech que está revolucionando a gestão de imóveis para investidores. title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.

title: MEP Manager
description:
MEP Manager - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We Are

ALEMCO, a trusted leader in integrated MEP and facilities services, is part of the ALEC Group. We are known for our innovative solutions, commitment to excellence, and ability to deliver complex projects on time and within budget. With expertise spanning design, procurement, and execution, we are building a legacy of iconic projects that define the region. Discover how your skills can make an impact.

Why Join Us?

As an MEP Manager at ALEMCO, you’ll play a critical leadership role, overseeing all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works on-site to ensure timely, safe, and compliant project execution. They collaborate closely with internal teams, subcontractors, and authorities, while managing design coordination, documentation, budgeting, and health & safety standards.

Your Role

  • Execution & Delivery: Full lifecycle management of MEP activities, from installation through commissioning.
  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Work with Construction, Commercial, Design, and Planning teams to ensure smooth operations.
  • Compliance & Quality: Maintain regulatory and safety compliance; drive continuous improvement across MEP procedures.
  • Team Leadership: Recruit, align, and engage MEP staff while promoting efficient workflows and cross-functional clarity.
  • Contractual Management: Ensure Head Contract terms are fulfilled, support cost/time claims, and manage document approvals.
  • Subcontractor Oversight: Supervise subcontractor progress, safety adherence, and delivery of finalized records and approvals.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  • Minimum 15 years of MEP and construction management experience
  • Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving abilities
  • Exceptional communication and cross-team collaboration skills

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to contribute to iconic infrastructure projects in the UAE.
  • A supportive environment that values innovation, teamwork, and technical excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Tax-free earnings & relocation package

Ready to Engineer the Future?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and play a key role in delivering high-performance MEP solutions for transformative projects.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Analista de Planejamento Pleno
description:
Atuando desde 1939, a Mercury Marine se consolidou como destaque global na fabricação de motores de popa e soluções para navegação. Com presença sólida no Brasil, atuamos com foco em inovação, confiabilidade, qualidade e alto desempenho, oferecendo produtos e serviços que atendem aos mais altos padrões do mercado náutico visando a satisfação máxima de nossos clientes e usuários.

A operação brasileira integra a Brunswick Corporation , um dos maiores grupos do setor marítimo mundial, e combina tecnologia de ponta com compromisso com a excelência e sustentabilidade.

Buscamos um(a) ANALISTA DE PLANEJAMENTO PLENO para atuar junto ao time de distribuição em nosso escritório no Rio de Janeiro e contribuir para a evolução dos processos em compras e planejamento de demanda.

Por favor, leia atentamente a descrição da vaga e candidate-se somente caso você atenda os pré-requisitos .

Principais atividades:

  • Analisar o ciclo de vida dos produtos;
  • Provisionar e planejar a demanda de itens de reposição;
  • Executar do cálculo reposição de produtos;
  • Analisar o fluxo dos pedidos de compra: alocação, embarque e recebimento;
  • Fornecer forecast de compra de todos os produtos;
  • Acompanhamento e análise do plano de reposição;
  • Conduzir a análise de faltas (back orders);
  • Apoiar o controle do nível de inventário;
  • Manter relacionamento com os fornecedores a fim de garantir a disponibilidade dos produtos de acordo com o planejamento;
  • Acompanhar os resultados através da criação de KPIs visando à melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Manter conhecimento profissional e técnico sobre a cadeia de suprimentos e análise de dados, com foco no planejamento de demanda e na gestão de estoques;

Para essa posição, o que o profissional precisa ser/ter?

  • Ser graduado(a) em Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Administração, Logística ou Engenharia de produção. Pós graduação desejável.
  • Possuir experiência prévia na área de Supply Chain ou Comércio Exterior. Mínimo de 4 anos
  • Ter inglês avançado
  • Ter domínio de pacote Office - intermediário ou avançado (Excel em especial).
  • Desejável ter conhecimento em sistemas ERP (Dynamics AX será considerado um diferencial)

+ Facilidade de comunicação e habilidade em se relacionar e interagir com pessoas em diferentes níveis dentro da organização no Brasil e exterior. Gostar de trabalhar com números e planilhas; Usar Excel e outras ferramentas de análises de dados; ser interessado(a) em aprender coisas novas; Gostar de trabalhar em equipe; solucionar problemas; pensar de forma criativa; executar múltiplas tarefas.

Habilidades Específicas: Domínio de Power BI é um diferencial.

É legal saber que...

Buscamos oferecer um ambiente de trabalho agradável ao nosso time

  • Trabalhamos no modelo hibrido: sendo 2 dias home office e dos 3 presenciais a quarta-feira é dia fixo presencial.
  • Adotamos jornada de trabalho flexível e de segunda à sexta, sendo 40h semanais.
  • Temos ginástica laboral 2 vezes por semana no escritório

Pacote de remuneração (Salário + benefícios):

  • Alelo Multi benefícios R$2.052,00 (mês);
  • Plano de saúde – profissional + dependentes - S/coparticipação S/desconto;
  • Planos odontológico – profissional + dependentes - S/coparticipação S/desconto;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte ou Vale Estacionamento;
  • Day-off de aniversário;
  • Convênios e parcerias;

Contratação: Terceirizada (Via grupo Seres) / tempo indeterminado

Sobre o processo seletivo, é constituído por algumas etapas, sendo:

1ª etapa: análise e triagem de currículos

2ª etapa: entrevista com RH - análise para aderência à vaga + testagem de inglês

3ª etapa: entrevista com gestor direto - somente os candidatos previamente aprovados

4ª etapa: entrevista com diretor da área - somente os candidatos previamente aprovados

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Project Engineer, you’ll oversee all engineering deliverables for your assigned scope, from design validation and approvals to procurement, compliance, and on-site execution. You’ll work alongside Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, and Foremen, coordinating closely with planning, commercial, and MEP teams to ensure successful delivery on time, on budget, and fully compliant.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

About Your Team

This role reports directly to the Operations Director and is part of the ALEC Data Centre Solutions core delivery team. The project delivery function oversees execution, programme coordination, stakeholder engagement, and quality control across all phases of construction. The team works closely with Planning, Commercial, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and Site Operations to ensure flawless execution.

Your Role

  • Review and interpret civil engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Coordinate with consultants, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate execution.
  • Prepare and manage material submittals, RFIs, method statements, and risk assessments.
  • Monitor site progress, ensuring compliance with quality standards, safety procedures, and timelines.
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, and progress documentation.
  • Support project planning, cost control, and procurement activities.
  • Assist in resolving technical and site-related issues proactively.
  • Participate in inspections, testing, and handover processes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in large-scale civil construction projects.
  • Strong technical understanding of concrete, formwork, structural works, and finishing.
  • Familiarity with construction codes, safety regulations, and QA/QC procedures.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, AutoCAD, and project planning tools (Primavera P6 or MS Project).
  • Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Banco de Talentos - Oportunidades Odebrecht Angola
description:
Olá, nós somos a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção .

Fazemos parte do Grupo Novonor e atuamos, principalmente, no Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos.

Temos mais de 80 anos de história, destes, 40 anos atuando em Angola, e nosso propósito é contribuir para a construção de um futuro sustentável, servindo à sociedade por meio da capacidade transformadora de nossa engenharia, acreditando e desenvolvendo profissionais locais para a realização do sonho dos nossos clientes.

Todos os dias, nos diversos países que atuamos, buscamos fornecer soluções para alguns dos maiores desafios do mundo - como educação, saúde, energia, água, transporte, habitação e saneamento.

  • Coordenador/a de Operações e Controle Offshore;

  • Supervisor/a de Plataforma de Carregamentos;
  • Supervisor/a de Transferência de Produtos;
  • Supervisor/a de Carga e Descarga de Navios;
  • Supervisor/a de Eletromecânica.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo.

A inscrição neste banco de talentos não garante a contratação, pois ela dependerá da avaliação de currículos e requisitos de cada uma das oportunidades.

Quem pode se candidatar?

Para as posições de nível gerencial e de coordenação, exigimos:

  • Especialização e / ou MBA nas respectivas formações ou áreas de atuação serão um diferencial;
  • Experiência profissional pregressa nos cargos listados;
  • Disponibilidade e mobilidade imediata para atuação 100% presencial na região de Barra do Dande (Angola).

  • Cursos e / ou certificações nas respectivas áreas de atuação são desejáveis;
  • Experiência profissional pregressa nos cargos listados;
  • Disponibilidade e mobilidade imediata para atuação 100% presencial na região de Barra do Dande (Angola).

Experiência Odebrecht Angola:

Aqui, valorizamos o convívio entre as gerações, integrando jovens e profissionais maduros, bem como na diversidade cultural. Acreditamos que o aprendizado acontece de múltiplas formas, oferecendo a nossos Integrantes a oportunidade de participar de programas de Trainees, Formação de Líderes, Mentoria para Mulheres, workshops técnicos e muito mais.

title: Subcontracts Specialist 25002832
description:
Job Overview:

The Subcontracts Specialist applies their conceptual knowledge of subcontracts and with a moderate level of guidance and direction from colleagues and leadership, is responsible for solving a range of straightforward subcontracts problems. They will be responsible for analyzing possible solutions using standard procedures, as well as building knowledge of the company, processes, and customers. The Subcontracts Specialist understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations through analysis of possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the performance and direction of subcontracts input into bid proposal activities including compilation of subcontractor bidding documents, evaluations, and other related information
  • Responsible for the performance and direction of all subcontracts commercial and administrative work within the project
  • Follow global procedures outlined in the management system
  • Maintain awareness of the content of the HSE (Health, Safety, & Environment) Plan and the actions required in the event of an emergency
  • Cooperate in the implementation of the HSE Plan overall and as it applies to subcontractors
  • Insure that contractual obligations are met by the subcontractor
  • Identify, evaluate, prepare, and subsequently agree to subcontract work scope changes and monitor risks to the project
  • Process changes with the subcontractor as directed by the Subcontract Manager or other lead
  • Develop and update cost subcontract forecasts for input to Project Controls Manager
  • Provide input to project weekly/monthly report

title: Offshore Cargo Supervisor
description:
We are looking for an Offshore Cargo Supervisor for one of our clients in O&G, in an offshore position (14 X 14).

Offshore Cargo Supervisor: What will your responsibilities and missions be?

Responsible for supervising, monitoring, and participating in all marine-related activities, such as offloading operations, transshipment with support vessels, cargo handling and cleaning, ballasting operations, tank washing (COW), equipment maintenance, diving operations, and pull-in/pull-out operations. All these activities must be carried out with a focus on safety and in compliance with internal and external procedures and regulations, always in support of the Marine Superintendent and under his authority. He is also jointly responsible for ensuring the readiness and availability of the offshore facility's rescue equipment.

What Profile and Skills are Required for this Cargo Supervisor Position?

  • Nationality: Brazilian Only
  • Local of work: Offshore – onboard FPSOs (boarding points: Jacarepaguá, Macaé, Farol de São Tomé, Cabo Frio, Maricá)
  • English: Intermediate to Advanced

Graduation/Certificate:

  • Minimum: Marine or technical background — e.g., Marinheiro de Convés, CB, Mestre de Cabotagem or equivalent maritime certification.
  • Required Certifications (valid at embark): CBSP, CACI, CESS, MCIA, NR-33 (Confined Space), NR-35 (Work at Heights), H2S Awareness, Benzeno Awareness, GASD, ECOW (modules 1 to 4)
  • Search parameters: COW AND Ballast Operations AND Diving Support AND Lifesaving Equipment AND Offshore Cargo Handling

Experience:

  • Proven experience in offshore cargo operations, marine logistics, ballast management, and tank cleaning procedures
  • Experience coordinating diving support and marine safety inspections

title: Principal Pipeline Drafter 25002281
description:
Company Overview:

People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing offshore platforms hundreds of miles from shore, and using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. Here, what you do matters.

Job Overview:

The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2D and 3D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software
  • Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints
  • Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables
  • Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures
  • Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities
  • Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools
  • Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team
  • Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing
  • Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN
  • Identify non-original scope using Change Management System

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in using CAD software, such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings
  • Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints
  • Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings
  • Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in drawing creation and review processes
  • Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination and interface management among various engineering disciplines
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Flexible and adaptable mindset to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno | DCP
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Planejamento em Prevenção de Perdas atua como o cérebro estratégico da operação, conectando análises financeiras, orçamentárias e contratuais à execução prática das ações de mitigação de perdas em toda a cadeia operacional. Seu papel é garantir o uso eficiente dos recursos destinados à Prevenção de Perdas, por meio do controle rigoroso de orçamento (budget), acompanhamento de CAPEX/OPEX, e gestão de contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia, segurança, auditoria e serviços correlatos.

Além disso, a área é responsável pelo provisionamento e reversão contábil de perdas, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e compliance com normas financeiras. A interlocução com áreas como Controladoria, Compras, Jurídico, Financeiro e Operações é constante, exigindo perfil analítico, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade sobre prazos e entregas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Garantir que os investimentos e despesas da área estejam aderentes ao budget anual, monitorando variações, evitando estouros e propondo realocações estratégicas quando necessário.
  • Assegurar o correto acompanhamento de vigência contratual, SLA, reajustes, aditivos e pagamentos de notas fiscais, evitando atrasos, glosas ou passivos.
  • Atuar como elo entre Prevenção de Perdas e áreas como Financeiro, Controladoria e Jurídico, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em ações financeiras/compliance e vice-versa.
  • Realizar estimativas confiáveis de perdas e investimentos, com metodologia clara para provisionamento e reversões, fundamentando tomadas de decisão do comitê executivo.
  • Equilibrar investimentos de capital (ex: instalação de novas tecnologias) e despesas operacionais (ex: manutenção de sistemas de CFTV) de forma eficiente e transparente.
  • Buscar constantemente formas de reduzir retrabalho, integrar sistemas (ERP, BI, etc.) e melhorar a previsibilidade e rastreabilidade de informações e custos.
  • Contribuir para a construção de um plano de perdas sustentável, que una a inteligência financeira ao propósito de proteger o negócio de riscos e desperdícios.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Domínio em gestão orçamentária e financeira.
  • Conhecimento em gestão contratual e compliance.
  • Habilidade em análise de perdas e provisionamento.
  • Conhecimento em investimentos de capital e despesas operacionais.
  • Vivência com sistemas integrados, como: ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, etc.), BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.)
  • Análise estratégica e mindset de negócios.
  • Pacote Office avançado.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: General Foreman
description:
General Foreman - Civil | UAE

Are you a hands-on construction leader with deep structural experience and a drive for delivering high-quality work on time, every time?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.

Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications : First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.
  • Planning & Coordination : Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.
  • Communication : Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.
  • Safety & Quality : Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.

What We Offer

title: Foreman
description:
Foreman – UAE

Are you a hands-on site leader with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and daily execution excellence?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Foreman, you’ll take frontline responsibility for executing daily site activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. You’ll lead your team on the ground, translating technical drawings into action and ensuring work progresses according to project plans.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner on some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value reliability, innovation, and our people. Join us to lead high-performing site teams that drive delivery excellence.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Senior Foreman and work closely with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, and supporting departments including QA/QC and planning. You’ll lead a small team of operatives and coordinate resources to maintain daily momentum and deliver consistent progress.

Your Role

As a Foreman, you will:

  • Lead daily site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, on time, and to the required quality.
  • Coordinate labour, materials, and equipment to optimise workflow and minimise downtime.
  • Enforce ALEC safety protocols and foster a culture of compliance and awareness.
  • Read and interpret drawings to ensure correct execution and alignment with design intent.
  • Monitor progress and take corrective action to overcome site-level challenges.
  • Maintain accurate records of progress and workforce deployment.
  • Support and motivate your team, resolve on-site issues, and escalate where required.
  • Contribute to improvements in efficiency, cost control, and construction methods.
  • This is a full-time role following a Monday to Saturday work week typical of site-based positions in our industry.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 5+ years in a Foreman or similar site-based supervisory role within the GCC.
  • Technical Knowledge : Practical understanding of construction activities, materials, and sequencing.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to guide and manage small site teams effectively.
  • Communication : Clear verbal and written communication with team members and engineers.
  • Skills : Skilled in site planning, resource coordination, and drawing interpretation.
  • Safety-First Mindset : Strong awareness of HSE principles and site compliance.
  • Tools : Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); First Aider certification preferred.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Especialista - Riscos Corporativos - Corporativo RJ
description:
Fundada em 1977, a Rede D’Or é a maior rede privada de assistência médica integrada do país, com 46 anos de existência.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D’Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

Requisitos:

- Superior completo nos cursos de Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;

- Pacote Office intermediário;

- Experiência prévia com gestão de riscos corporativos;

- Diferencial ter experiência com gestão integrada de riscos;

- Conhecimento das normas e frameworks relacionados a riscos (ex: ISO 31000, COSO ERM, COBIT, etc.);

- Conhecimento de controles internos e levantamento de processos.

Atividades:

- Implementar e manter a metodologia de gestão de riscos com base em boas práticas, como a ISO 31000;

- Identificar, avaliar e monitorar os riscos corporativos em conjunto com as áreas de negócio;

- Apoiar a definição de planos de ação para mitigação de riscos e acompanhar sua efetividade;

- Conduzir workshops, treinamentos e avaliações periódicas de risco (Risk Assessment);

- Participar na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e reportes executivos de riscos;

- Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Compliance, Controles Internos, Auditoria e Segurança da Informação;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento da cultura de riscos na organização;

- Realizar análises de riscos emergentes e tendências de mercado.

Outras informações:

- Botafogo (RJ);

- 2ª a 5ª - 08h às 18h | 6ª 08h às 17h.

title: Draughtsman - Civil
description:
Civil Draughtsman - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil Draughtsman , you will be responsible for creating the technical drawings and plans that serve as the foundation for our construction projects. You will transform architectural and engineering concepts into accurate, detailed drawings that guide project teams through every phase of construction. Your work will ensure that our designs are clearly communicated, compliant with regulations, and efficiently executed on site.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Prepare detailed architectural and structural drawings for building construction projects.
  • Develop general arrangement (GA) drawings, foundation plans, sections, elevations, and detail drawings.
  • Support the design team by translating conceptual sketches and technical data into accurate CAD drawings.
  • Collaborate on the development of structural layouts, floor plans, and utility networks.
  • Update and revise designs based on feedback from engineers, architects, or site observations.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with local building codes, design standards, and project specifications.
  • Maintain organized and version-controlled drawing files within the design department.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (electrical, mechanical) to ensure design integration and conflict resolution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Familiarity with Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM software is advantageous.
  • Understanding of construction methods, site logistics, and temporary works.
  • Experience with local authority drawing submissions and approval processes.
  • Bachelor's in Civil Engineering / Drafting Technology or equivalent.
  • Proven experience as a draughtsman in the building construction or architectural design industry.
  • High proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM tools are a strong advantage.
  • Good understanding of civil and structural design principles and building systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple design tasks simultaneously.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão?

• Assinar as demonstrações financeiras da companhia como contador responsável (CRC ativo obrigatório).

• Liderar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, com precisão, pontualidade e compliance, assegurando conformidade com CPCs, IFRS e exigências da SEC.

• Consolidar as demonstrações financeiras da companhia e preparar os reportes ao controlador internacional conforme regras globais.

• Elaborar e revisar notas explicativas às demonstrações financeiras, com ênfase na Nota 08 – Instrumentos Financeiros e Política de Hedge, abrangendo a contabilização de derivativos, aplicação de hedge accounting (cash flow e fair value hedge), gestão de exposições cambiais e riscos de mercado.

• Atuar como referência técnica em normas contábeis, com domínio em: IFRS 16 – Arrendamentos, CPC 25 – Provisões, Passivos Contingentes e Ativos Contingentes, e CPC 27 – Ativo Imobilizado.

• Liderar a estruturação e manutenção de políticas contábeis e controles internos relacionados às rotinas contábeis.

• Promover a transformação da área contábil, reestruturando processos, times e entregas com foco em compliance, eficiência e escalabilidade.

• Ser protagonista nas interações com áreas pares, promovendo soluções conjuntas e sinergias nos processos de fechamento e reporte.

• Liderar, desenvolver e engajar o time contábil, com foco em performance e entregas confiáveis.

• Contribuir com a implementação e/ou evolução de sistemas ERP, com uso intensivo de SAP (preferencialmente), incluindo histórico de participação em projetos.

• Apoiar a jornada de fortalecimento da governança corporativa e crescimento sustentável da organização, combinando visão estratégica e conhecimento técnico.

Para isso, precisamos que você possua :

• Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no CRC (obrigatório).

• Pós-graduação em Controladoria, Finanças ou áreas correlatas de Business.

• Inglês avançado, com fluência verbal e escrita para comunicação com auditorias e stakeholders internacionais.

• Desejável: Especialização ou certificação formal em normas internacionais de contabilidade (IFRS).

• Experiência em contabilidade de empresas de capital aberto no Brasil e/ou exterior.

• Desejável vivência em processos de IPO ou ambiente pré-IPO.

• Passagem por Big Four será considerada um diferencial relevante.

• Domínio das normas IFRS e CPCs aplicáveis.

• Vivência com ERP SAP e experiência em implementação ou melhorias de sistemas.

• Perfil de liderança colaborativa, com forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e orientação para soluções.

• Mentalidade de transformação e protagonismo, com atuação técnica sólida e visão estratégica de longo prazo.

title: Consultant
description:
This role can be in Sao Paulo or Rio.

Heidrick Consulting Brazil

You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.

You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as an Engagement Leader, you will expand and deepen your consulting skills by leading various projects as well as managing junior team members. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.

Primary Responsibilities

The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.

You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
  • Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
  • Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
  • Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
  • Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
  • Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
  • Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
  • Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
  • Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.

The Ideal Candidate:

Passionate and Engaged: Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.

Self-Driven and Inquisitive: Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.

Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player: Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.

Minimum Role Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
  • An undergraduate degree is required.
  • Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
  • Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
  • Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
  • Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.

E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
No software farms and no part-time jobs at the moment. We build our software in-house.

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with strong product instincts. As an early-stage startup, our projects are broad—so comfort moving across the stack and owning outcomes end-to-end is key. You’ll design and run the infrastructure that powers Findly, from CI/CD to Kubernetes, with a big focus on reliability, security, and developer velocity. System design experience is a plus.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Deep experience with a major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Strong with IaC (Terraform/Pulumi) and CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • Containers & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Observability (logs/metrics/traces) and incident response
  • Proficiency in Python for automation
  • Solid networking/security fundamentals
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have:

  • MLOps exposure (model serving, feature stores, data pipelines)
  • Cost optimization at scale; platform/SRE background

Projects include:

  • Designing and operating secure, scalable cloud infrastructure
  • Building fast, reliable release pipelines
  • Managing Kubernetes clusters and service meshes
  • Implementing observability and on-call practices
  • Automating environments, secrets, and compliance guardrails
  • Partnering with ML/backend teams to productionize model services

At Findly, engineers own what they build—from prototype to production.

  • Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais : Auxiliar na construção de dashboards e KPIs que suportem a tomada de decisão da liderança, com foco em eficiência operacional, controle de custos e performance dos parceiros.

Cadastre o seu currículo e boa sorte!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiências.

Sobre o Grupo Generali

A Generali é um dos maiores grupos globais de gestão de ativos e seguros. Fundada em 1831, está presente em mais de 50 países ao redor do mundo, com uma receita total de prêmios de 95,2 bilhões de euros em 2024. title: Souring Specialist
description:

As a Sourcing Specialist, you will be responsible for identifying, developing, and managing supplier relationships that bring innovative and high-quality products to market. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the product pipeline by ensuring a balance of cost efficiency, quality, and speed-to-market, while upholding sustainability and compliance standards.

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard suppliers across the fashion, beauty, and cosmetics categories.
  • Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms to secure competitive advantages.
  • Collaborate with design, merchandising, and product development teams to launch new products.
  • Conduct market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Ensure supplier compliance with ethical sourcing and sustainability requirements.
  • Manage end-to-end sourcing processes, from supplier selection to product delivery.
  • Build and maintain long-term partnerships with both local and international suppliers.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven track record in sourcing, procurement, or buying within fashion, beauty, or cosmetics.
  • Strong supplier network and market knowledge in Brazil and LATAM.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English (Portuguese and/or Spanish strongly preferred).
  • Highly analytical with the ability to balance creativity and commercial thinking.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Fashion Management, or a related field.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with a leading international organization with global reach.
  • A collaborative and innovative culture where your ideas truly matter.
  • Career growth in an exciting and evolving industry.
  • Competitive package with the chance to directly influence business success.

title: Gerente Regional de RH | RJ | ES | MG
description:

title: CHAIR of CEO Advisory Board Group
description:
Chair - Vistage

A Vistage, com mais de 40.000 membros, é a organização líder mundial para CEOs e proprietários de negócios. Além de sua escala, a Vistage é uma comunidade onde líderes empresariais experientes e apaixonados podem compartilhar conhecimentos e casos reais para ajudar uns aos outros a crescer e alcançar objetivos pessoais e profissionais.

Há mais de 20 anos, a Vistage tem ajudado membros no Brasil a tomar melhores decisões com sua metodologia altamente eficaz e proprietária.

Visão Geral da Função:

O Chair da Vistage é uma posição estratégica que combina os papéis de facilitador, mentor e coach para nossos membros. O Chair é fundamental na implementação de nossa metodologia e na condução das experiências transformadoras dentro de nossa comunidade.

Como Chair da Vistage, você liderará grupos de líderes empresariais de diversos setores que compartilham desafios comuns. Seja como proprietários de seus negócios ou CEOs de empresas nacionais e internacionais, todos os membros estão unidos por um objetivo comum: buscar aconselhamento e orientação de seus pares para superar o isolamento típico de um número um.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e facilitar reuniões de grupo de líderes empresariais.
  • Proporcionar mentoria e coaching individual aos membros.
  • Implementar e manter a metodologia proprietária da Vistage.
  • Fomentar um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio para que os membros compartilhem conhecimentos e experiências.
  • Promover o engajamento e a retenção dos membros através de liderança eficaz e gestão de relacionamentos.
  • Construir e iniciar um grupo de, no mínimo, 8 membros e expandi-lo para 16 membros nos meses seguintes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia como alto executivo: Experiência como CEO, C-level, Managing Director, Diretor Geral ou cargos similares.
  • Disponibilidade para dedicar tempo na formação do grupo e depois de formado, ter de 10 a 15 dias por mês para dedicar às reuniões (em grupo e individuais).
  • Extensa rede de contatos e relacionamentos.
  • Fortes habilidades de vendas e prospecção.
  • Capacidade financeira para gerenciar a fase inicial.
  • Capacidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.
  • CNPJ aberto para contrato B2B.

Remuneração:

Mensal e variável. Os ganhos são diretamente proporcionais ao número de grupos/membros coordenados e ao tempo dedicado à função.

Modelo de Atuação:

O Chair atua como um profissional autônomo com liberdade para gerenciar sua agenda de acordo com as necessidades dos membros.

Reunião de grupo mensal obrigatória - presencial.

Reuniões individuais mensais com cada membro - online ou presencial (flexível).

Depoimento de um Chair:

"O que mais me gratifica na minha função de Chair é saber que ajudei os meus membros a crescerem, não somente dentro de suas companhias, mas também como pessoas."

Se você é um ex-executivo de alto nível buscando consolidar sua carreira como conselheiro ou consultor e deseja causar um impacto significativo nos líderes empresariais, candidate-se agora para se juntar à Vistage e liderar um grupo de profissionais de alto nível em sua jornada para o sucesso!

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes comerciais e vendas de alto valor.

  • Salário fixo competitivo.

Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.

Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

title: Principal Installation Analysis Engineer 25003289
description:
Job Overview:

The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Installation Analysis-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Installation Analysis. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in Installation Analysis as well as broad knowledge of the Installation Analysis discipline within the Engineering function.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Apply in-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and - procedures
  • Manage own time to meet objectives and (as Lead Engineer) forecast and plan resource requirements
  • Communicate and explain difficult concepts and persuade others to adopt a point of view
  • When acting as Lead Engineer, in addition:
  • Direct an Engineering team as a Lead Engineer
  • Lead the Discipline engineering design of the assigned work area and complete it within the planned schedule and budget, in accordance with standards, MDR, and project-specific procedures and to a high professional standard
  • Plan, organize, and direct all aspects of Discipline execution on the assigned project including scope, deliverables, schedule, and all manpower resources - agree allocations with the Discipline Manager
  • Ensure interfaces and deliverables are clearly identified
  • Maintain responsibility for progress and productivity, identifying any required corrective action
  • Act as project representative for Discipline during meetings with the Project Team, Customer discipline lead, and relevant agencies such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.
  • Become fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address issues, interpreting contractual requirements as they relate to engineering execution
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for variation orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash-free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to Discipline Lead Engineer and Discipline Manager
  • Prepare estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and manhour estimates, identifying software requirements and any other project-specific requirements
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications
  • Participate in finalizing deliverable lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Review project schedule and fabrication schedule in relation to construction sequence, milestones, and engineering scope
  • Attend project kickoff and review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve design reports and procedures
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • Assist procurement personnel in procuring discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing, reviewing, and (as Lead Engineer) approving requisitions, evaluating technical quotations, and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as necessary
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve design verification through single-discipline check /inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Discipline Manager and Project Management Team apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Check final subcontractor and vendor data manuals to ensure that all requested data has been received and approved
  • Present issues and problems to Customers in a timely manner and assist the Lead Engineer in negotiating resolution in accordance with project and company requirements
  • Perform (as required) Technical Quality Audit reviews in accordance with MDR Global Procedures
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Supervise and guide assigned engineers and coordinate with Lead Designers for Discipline engineering and design deliverables
  • Responsible for the engineering integrity of the assigned work area
  • Monitor costs of own work processes
  • Assist in the maintenance of departmental technical guidelines and standard calculation notes
  • Participate in development and maintenance of Global Procedures, Software, and Standards
  • May participate in standards development committees or task groups such as API
  • Develop communication and presentation skills (e.g., write technical papers, participate in conferences and/or seminars, present design solutions, and/or present topics at ‘lunch and learn’; etc.)
  • Identify and provide training to staff in specific techniques and proprietary software
  • Provide information on employee performance to the Discipline Manager
  • Assist the Discipline manager in interviewing job applicants
  • Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Pipeline Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids):
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Structural Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids) of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • When acting as Lead engineer, in addition:
  • Act as project-based discipline point of contact in communications and meetings with customer counterparts
  • Ensure substantive communications are documented
  • Prepare bids and projects discipline engineering budget and execution plans
  • Identify project staff needs based on knowledge of individual engineer’s skill sets and provide requests to the discipline manager
  • Plan, organize, and assign tasks, responsibilities, and manhour budgets to the discipline team, and verify tasks are completed within budgets
  • Plan discipline deliverable schedule/register compliant with the overall execution plan
  • Prepare work forecasts identifying change management plans, corrective action, and real-time schedule
  • Provide discipline inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master’s is a preference)
  • 15-20 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Detailed knowledge of design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the theory, content, and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable Knowledgeable in project coordination and execution skills
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society
